title: Why renting isn't throwing money away

headline: Renting is
throwing money away
right?
scenes.say: You have heard it your whole life. Renting is throwing money away. Buying builds wealth. But that sentence hides something.
Shelter is never free. A renter pays a landlord. An owner pays a bank, a tax office, and a roof that keeps breaking.
In the first years of a mortgage, almost every payment goes to interest, not to the house. Add property tax, insurance and repairs, and a big slice of an owner's money disappears too.

headline: The real question:
what do you do
with the difference?
scenes.say: So the real question is not rent or buy. It is this. What do you do with the money you did not spend?
A renter who invests the difference can finish ahead. A renter who spends it finishes behind. The house was never the magic part.

headline: Renting is rent.
Owning is rent
you pay to a bank.
scenes.say: Renting is not wasted money. It is just a different landlord. Follow for more money ideas explained simply.
